title: EBP section 9 - Cameras (CAM7)

container.notes: EBP section 9 (cameras; magic 'CAM7', three u32 list counts, 12 unknown bytes, u32 offset of the first list at 0x1C (0x20 when rebuilt), then three lists of variable-size blocks stored back to back (camera blocks, list-2 blocks, list-3 blocks), zero padding to 16. Nothing is aligned inside the section. Camera blocks hold typed entries: read the u8 kind at entry+0 (1 = 64-byte camera key, 2 = 44-byte entry)). EBP = *.ebp, 0x80-byte header: magic 'EBP2' at 0x00, twenty u32 section offsets at 0x10-0x5F counted from the EBP start (0 = absent; this section = u32 at EBP+0x34), 0x04-0x0F and 0x60-0x7F not interpreted. Sections start on 16-byte boundaries with zero fill; a section spans to the next larger non-zero offset (the highest to end of file), so the span includes padding. Section 6 is a TIM2 texture and section 19 an embedded ARD (FF12AR03); a rebuild must carry both. Little-endian throughout.

records.name: cam7Header
records.where: Offset 0 of EBP section 9 (EBP start + u32 at EBP+0x34).

fields.name: magic
fields.notes: ASCII 'CAM7' = 43 41 4D 37.

fields.name: cameraBlockCount
fields.notes: Number of camera blocks (list 1).

fields.name: list2Count
fields.notes: Number of list-2 blocks.

fields.name: list3Count
fields.notes: Number of list-3 blocks.

fields.name: unknown10
fields.notes: Not interpreted (zeros from the Workshop). Possibly further list offsets; preserve.

fields.name: listStart
fields.notes: Offset (from the section start) of the first camera block; lists 2 and 3 follow list 1 without their own offsets. 0x20 in rebuilt files.

records.name: cameraBlockHeader
records.where: List 1: first block at cam7Header.listStart; each next block starts at previous block start + blockSize.

fields.name: unknown00
fields.notes: Not interpreted (zero from the Workshop). Preserve.

fields.name: blockSize
fields.notes: Total block length in bytes from +0x00 through the 4-byte footer = 44 + sum of entry sizes. Entries run from +0x28 to blockSize-4.

fields.name: label
fields.notes: Camera name, Shift-JIS, padded with 0x00 (24 bytes may be used without terminator).

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Flag word; bits not identified.

records.name: cameraKey
records.where: Inside a camera block, entries follow one another from block+0x28; an entry whose u8 at +0 is 1 has this 64-byte layout.
records.count: per block: entries with kind 1 (walk the block)

fields.name: kind
fields.notes: Always 1 for this layout.

fields.name: pad01
fields.notes: Not interpreted (zeros from the Workshop).

fields.name: cameraX
fields.notes: 4-float vector labelled 'Camera' (probably the eye position; 4th component unknown).

fields.name: viewAngleX
fields.notes: 4-float vector labelled 'View Angle' (look direction or target; unverified).

fields.name: rollDegrees
fields.notes: Camera roll in degrees.

fields.name: verticalFovDegrees
fields.notes: Vertical field of view in degrees (the live camera stores radians; the file stores degrees).

fields.name: unknown34
fields.notes: Probably unused (labelled with a question mark). Preserve.

fields.name: unknown3C
fields.notes: Probably unused (labelled with a question mark). Preserve.

records.name: cameraType2Entry
records.where: Inside a camera block: an entry whose u8 at +0 is 2 has this 44-byte layout.
records.count: per block: entries with kind 2 (walk the block)

fields.name: kind
fields.notes: Always 2 for this layout.

fields.name: pad01
fields.notes: Not interpreted (zeros from the Workshop).

fields.name: wordA00
fields.notes: First of 13 consecutive u16 values (0x04-0x1D), meaning unknown.

fields.name: wordB0
fields.notes: First of 2 consecutive u16 values (0x1E-0x21), meaning unknown.

fields.name: unknown26
fields.notes: Probably unused (labelled with a question mark). Preserve.

records.name: cameraBlockFooter
records.where: Last 4 bytes of each camera block: block start + blockSize - 4.

fields.name: footer
fields.notes: Unknown value closing every camera block.

records.name: list2Block
records.where: List 2: first block directly after the last camera block; each next block at previous start + blockSize (= 24 + 36*entryCount).

fields.name: blockSize
fields.notes: Block length = 24 + 36*entryCount (recomputed by the Workshop, not read by it).

fields.name: entryCount
fields.notes: Number of 36-byte list2Entry rows at +0x18.

fields.name: value0
fields.notes: Nine floats, meaning unknown (possibly three 3D vectors).

records.name: list3Block
records.where: List 3: first block directly after the last list-2 block; each next block at previous start + blockSize (= 32 + 56*vectorEntryCount + 8*pairEntryCount).

fields.name: blockSize
fields.notes: Block length = 32 + 56*vectorEntryCount + 8*pairEntryCount (recomputed by the Workshop, not read by it).

fields.name: vectorEntryCount
fields.notes: Number of 56-byte list3VectorEntry rows at +0x20.

fields.name: pairEntryCount
fields.notes: Number of 8-byte list3PairEntry rows after the vector rows.

fields.name: vecAX
fields.notes: First 3-float vector, meaning unknown.

fields.name: vecBX
fields.notes: Second 3-float vector, meaning unknown.

fields.name: vecAX
fields.notes: Three 4-float vectors and two scalars, meaning unknown.

fields.name: unknown34
fields.notes: Probably unused (labelled with a question mark). Preserve.

fields.name: value0
fields.notes: Two floats, meaning unknown.

roundTrip: Keep the magic 'CAM7', header bytes 0x10-0x1B and listStart as read.

Walk the section strictly: listStart -> camera blocks (each blockSize long; entries from +0x28 to blockSize-4, layout chosen by the kind byte) -> list-2 blocks -> list-3 blocks. Stop and refuse to edit if a kind other than 1 or 2 appears or the walk overruns the section.
In-place edits of floats, flags and u16/u8 values change nothing else.
Keep the 24-byte label field as raw bytes (do not strip interior zero bytes); a new label must fit in 24 Shift-JIS bytes, padded with 0x00.
Keep unknown00, pad bytes, footer and the probably-unused words as read.

Adding or removing an entry inside a camera block changes that block's blockSize (by 64 or 44) and moves everything after it; update cam7Header counts when blocks are added or removed, and blockSize/entryCount/vectorEntryCount/pairEntryCount for list-2/3 blocks.
After any size change, zero-pad the section end to 16 bytes.

If the section length changes, every EBP section stored after it moves: recompute their u32 slots at EBP+0x10+4n, keep 16-byte starts with zero fill, keep absent sections at 0, keep section 6 (TIM2) and section 19 (ARD) intact.
gaps: What list 2 and list 3 describe (camera paths, shakes, collision volumes?). The runtime also tracks camera shakes and lights (Toolkit), but no source ties them to these lists.
Meaning of header bytes 0x10-0x1B (possibly offsets of lists 2 and 3) and whether the game uses listStart or assumes 0x20.
Meaning of cameraW / viewAngleW, unknown2C/30/38, flags, unknown24/26 and the footer word.
Meaning of every field of the kind-2 entry.
Whether vanilla blockSize values for list-2/3 blocks always equal the formula (the Workshop never reads them).
How camera blocks are referenced (by index through CML1 section 8, or by their own label).
